name: SmartGit
blurb: SmartGit is a powerful, cross-platform Git GUI that works the way you do.
description:
SmartGit is a powerful, cross-platform Git GUI that works the way you do.

SmartGit is particularly known for its user-friendly interface and robust features that cater
to both beginners and experienced users.

Key Features

• Cross-platform support — works on GNU/Linux, macOS, and Windows

• User-friendly interface — users can adjust the interface to fit their workflow

•
Advanced Git functionality — features an intuitive conflict solver for easy merging; allows
users to split, rewrite, reorder, and squash commits for better organization

•
Pricing and licensing — free of charge for open-source developers, employees and students of
public academic institutions and employees of public charitables organizations, primarily
targeting philanthropy, health research, education or social well-being

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
